clue.definition: a small sign that helps you decide something, like a word or a mark in a message

score.definition: a number made by adding up points

threshold.definition: a line a number has to reach; at or above it, one thing happens, below it, another

training.definition: the way a program works out its own settings from many examples, instead of a person setting them by hand

filter.definition: something that lets some things through and holds others back
